name: spatial_overflow_crossfeeding
title: Spatial overflow & cross-feeding substrate
claim: Spatial dFBA on the COMETS field secretes acetate (overflow metabolism) that accumulates in the field while biomass grows and glucose begins to be drawn down — establishing the acetate pool a cross-feeding partner would exploit.

purpose.question: Does spatial dynamic-FBA secrete an overflow metabolite (acetate) into the field as it grows on glucose, building the substrate pool that spatial cross-feeding would draw on?
purpose.mechanism: New biology-forward study (discovery engine): a new configuration/analysis of a real spatio-flux composite.
purpose.expected_outcome: The quantitative behavior tests pass, confirming the stated emergent/metabolic claim.

question: Does spatial dynamic-FBA secrete an overflow metabolite (acetate) into the field as it grows on glucose, building the substrate pool that spatial cross-feeding would draw on?

behavior_tests.name: SPATIAL-OVERFLOW-ACETATE-ACCUMULATES
behavior_tests.description: total acetate in the field rises as an overflow byproduct.

behavior_tests.name: SPATIAL-OVERFLOW-GLUCOSE-DEPLETES
behavior_tests.description: total glucose is drawn down over the run (monotone decreasing; only ~5% over this horizon on the large lattice).

findings.statement: As the spatial population grows on glucose it secretes acetate into the field (overflow metabolism), accumulating the very substrate a cross-feeding partner would consume — the spatial precondition for cross-feeding, measured directly.

resolved: Acetate accumulates in the field as an overflow byproduct of spatial growth on glucose.
remaining: Whether the secreted acetate is re-consumed (true cross-feeding) once glucose is locally exhausted is not yet observed at this horizon.

followup_study_proposals.motivation: Acetate only accumulates here because glucose is far from exhausted on the large lattice. Run to glucose exhaustion (or a glucose-limited field) to test whether acetate is re-consumed — the peak-then-decline cross-feeding signature.
followup_study_proposals.candidate: comets_diffusion, longer horizon / reduced initial glucose

SPATIAL-OVERFLOW-ACETATE-ACCUMULATES.detail: increasing; steps [0,0.02069]; net +0.2409; start 0 end 0.2409; tol 0.02

SPATIAL-OVERFLOW-BIOMASS-GROWS.detail: increasing; steps [0.007999,0.1041]; net +2.571; start 0.2 end 2.771; tol 0.02

SPATIAL-OVERFLOW-GLUCOSE-DEPLETES.detail: decreasing; steps [-1.163,0]; net -25.06; start 500.5 end 475.4; tol 0.02

falsifiability: If acetate stayed at zero while biomass grew on glucose, the overflow-secretion claim would be false.
limitations: Acetate accumulation is shown; its re-consumption (true cross-feeding) is not reached at this horizon.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The acetate rise is a numerical artifact of the field solver.
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: Acetate accrues as glucose is consumed and biomass grows, and the zero-carbon control (nutrient_starvation_control) produces none.
